**[IMPDH inhibition enhances cytarabine efficacy in SAMHD1-expressing leukaemia cells via guanine nucleotide depletion.](https://pubmed.ncbi.nlm.nih.gov/41711315/)** *(from Oncology/hematology (AML pharmacology))*  
*Yagüe-Capilla Miriam; Dirks Christopher; Eiden Caroline; Fesenmayer Sonja K; Hor* — Molecular oncology 2026  
Score: **7/10** | Pathways: `dNTPase, nucleotide-rewiring, treatment-target, BIK-cancer, other`  
> The paper shows that IMPDH inhibition (mycophenolic acid, ribavirin) depletes guanine nucleotides and unbalances dNTP pools, which modulates SAMHD1 dNTPase activity and ara-C hydrolysis in leukaemic cells. This is directly relevant to the dGTP/dNTP-pool axis behind the A565T haploinsufficiency mechanism, and it points to a possible therapeutic lever (guanine nucleotide depletion) and to chemotherapy hypersensitivity in carriers. It is an oncology cell-line study with no A565T, heterozygous, interferon or mitochondrial data, so it is not a direct mechanistic demonstration in the disease.  
DOI: 10.1002/1878-0261.70226

**[Mitochondrial Dysfunction as a Context-Dependent Driver and Amplifier of the SASP: Targeting the mtDNA-cGAS-STING Axis for Next-Generation Senotherapeutics.](https://doi.org/10.1111/jcmm.71419)** *(from Geroscience / cellular senescence biology)*
